ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   B. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   D. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)

   C. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   C. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   B. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).

13. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

15. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   C. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Taraweeh and Witr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Swadaqah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Nullifiers of Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues Generosity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling 02 5.4 Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
